title: Resolve final-bar double-line consumer differences
scope: Classify the final-bar double-line difference between legacy import and the pinned GPIF consumer before changing serialization.
acceptance: Reproduce the last-bar difference in testdata/gp4/Slides.gp4 and inspect emitted DoubleBar XML.
Show whether a supported GP8 wire representation can retain the final visual bar line despite AlphaTab clearing the flag.
Implement and test a supported representation, or record a narrow target limit and precise preflight behavior without weakening ordinary double-bar assertions.
exclusions: Do not remove all final-bar comparisons or normalize every bar line.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
target-limit: Go emits and reparses DoubleBar; the final-bar difference is pinned-consumer finalization. No writer change is justified.

Reproduce both final and non-final double bars. Assert exact DoubleBar XML and Go reparse before comparing pinned AlphaTab finalization. Show that only the final projected flag is cleared and ordinary non-final double-bar evidence remains exact. Keep the wire flag; never delete authored data just to match a derived consumer projection. Record the consumer-only normalization and the verified tests/commit, then resolve this investigation when its checklist passes. If visual terminal-bar fidelity remains required, name a visual/retaining oracle as separate scope. This does not block #109 global stylesheet keys.
